title: Gatehouse Deployment Readiness Manual
summary: A pragmatic, single-page manual for preparing, executing and validating feature deployments across traffic buckets. Emphasizes measurable gates, discovery probes, and explicit rollback criteria so PM/Eng/OPS can go from beta to general availability with a clear escalation map.
objectives: Define lightweight gates that scale with risk (probe -> staged -> full)
Standardize a KPI surface and thresholds that are actionable during rollout
Document team responsibilities and on-call runbook for first 48h
Provide a concise contingency ladder tied to observable signals and cost impact
traffic_buckets: Probe (0.1% traffic): smoke canary for functional correctness and severe error signals
Staged (1% -> 10% over 24-72h): validate latency, errors, and user behavior at scale
Ramp (10% -> 50%): capacity, cost, and UX metrics under realistic mixes
Open (100%): GA but with higher-frequency sampling and extended retention of telemetry
acceptance_criteria: No functional regression on core flows in Probe (automated smoke + manual sanity)
Error rate (5xx + client-signaled failures) <= 0.2% sustained over 60m during Staged
P95 latency delta vs baseline < 30ms for Hosted API; < 10% for Dedicated profiles
Embeddings cosine drift within expected bounds (see Eval suite ID EVAL-378)
No increase in token cost per successful request > 15% without documented tradeoff approval
kpis: API Error Rate (5xx) | baseline 0.06% | probe threshold 0.5% | staged rollback 0.2%
User-facing Latency P95 | baseline 320ms | staged threshold 450ms | ramp threshold 520ms
Token Cost per 1k successful requests | baseline $1.12 | acceptable increase <= 15% during ramp
Quality Signal: Eval pass-rate on golden prompts | baseline 92% | unacceptable drop >= 4pp
timeline: T-7d: Postmortem & risk notes from last related rollout consolidated
T-5d: Lock down migration scripts and test-data sets; staging bake started
T-3d: Canary smoke checklist validated; alert pages authored
T-1d: Ops rehearsal (15m run-through) and on-call assignment confirmed
Day 0 10:30: Verify smoke, promote to Staged 1% if green
Day 1 -> Day 3: Gradual ramp with checkpoints every 6h
Day 4: Decision window for Ramp-to-Open based on KPI panel
contingency_triggers: High-severity error spike: any 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 15m -> immediate pause and rollback to previous model variant
Latency staggers over 3 consecutive checkpoints -> pause ramp, enable throttling circuit, open incident bridge
Quality regression on golden prompt set >= 4 percentage points -> pause and run targeted eval + model slice review
Cost shock: token-cost increase > 25% month-over-month projection for feature usage -> require finance approval before further ramp
post_go_live_checks: 48h heartbeat: no unexplained spikes in errors or latencies; owners confirm stability
7d retention snapshot: sampling of generated outputs against golden set for drift detection
Billing delta check: finance to validate cost per-usage aligns with preflight model
Telemetry retention: keep high-fidelity traces for 14 days for first release week
escalation_path: Pager: on-call SRE -> if unresolved 30m escalate to Eng TL
Product lead alerted if user-impacting for > 15m
Exec notification for customer-SLA breach or major incident > 60m
runbook_quick_steps: 1) Pause traffic at gateway and demote feature flag to previous value
2) Rehydrate previous model variant in serving clusters using rollback script (r/rollback-quick.sh)
3) Notify channel #prodops-incident and spawn incident bridge
4) Collect diagnostics: recent traces, top failing requests, cost delta snapshot
5) Triage to a debugging owner and open a critical bug ticket referencing PRODOPS-1427
open_questions_and_risks: SLA implication for Dedicated customers when model variant auto-fallback occurs (need legal/finance signoff)
Small-percentage traffic experiments may miss rare failure modes; consider targeted synthetic workloads
Current alert thresholds tuned for general workloads — may need lowering for latency-sensitive enterprise customers
notes: This manual attempts to be concise and operational. If you're running a high-risk feature (data plane changes, schema migrations, or new tensor formats), attach the expanded migration checklist (linked) and involve Platform Eng early. After GA, archive this record with a short debrief and cost impact analysis.
final_checklist: Feature flag created and tested in staging
Linked eval suite ID and golden prompts attached
